refnamediv.refpurpose: Consume a partition from its own queue

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public RdKafka\QueueRdKafka\KafkaConsumer::splitPartitionQueue stringtopic intpartition
Stops forwarding the partition's messages to the consumer queue and returns the partition's own queue. Read it with RdKafka\Queue::consume, which returns messages, partition EOF events and partition errors. Offsets are stored and committed as for messages returned by RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::consume.
Split partitions in the rebalance callback before acknowledging the assignment, and release their queues after the partitions are revoked. Messages that already reached the consumer queue stay there, so consume those first to keep the partition's order. Keep calling RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::consume to serve rebalance, offset commit and other callbacks and the partitions that are not split.
The split belongs to librdkafka's state for the partition, not to the RdKafka\Queue object. Releasing the queue does not send the partition's messages back to the consumer queue, and splitting the partition again returns the messages that were waiting. librdkafka discards the partition's state only after its topic has been deleted for longer than topic.metadata.propagation.max.ms while the partition is not assigned; a queue that is still held then refers to the discarded state until it is released.
Each call for the same partition returns the same RdKafka\Queue object while it is in use. The queue keeps the consumer alive, and is invalidated by RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close or the consumer's destruction; an asynchronous close finishing does not invalidate it. To be notified about the partition's messages, enable notifications on this queue with RdKafka\Queue::ioEventEnable.
Each split partition has its own queued.max.messages.kbytes limit, so splitting many partitions allows more prefetched data in memory. See fetch.queue.backoff.ms in librdkafka's configuration documentation as well.

&reftitle.parameters;
topic
Topic name. It must not contain null bytes.
partition
Partition ID.
